name: Evercraft Clip Social Video Production
problem: An authorized user needs a source video turned into a small set of social-ready vertical clips with bounded rendering, transparent limits and governed downstream distribution.
use_when: turn this video into social clips
make short vertical clips from a long video
find the best moments in this video for social media
create vertical clips from an interview
repurpose this video for Facebook LinkedIn and Instagram
make reels from an authorized source video
turn approved media into social-ready outputs
plan a social video clipping job
AI tool to select moments from a video and render social clips
inputs: Authorized source video. Current customer renderer is bounded to 35 MiB. Optional source duration, desired social goal and target platforms improve planning.
outputs: Up to 3 planned or rendered vertical clips, 8-45 seconds each, with 720x1280 MP4 H.264/AAC output in the authenticated paid workflow. Clip V2 adds clean/bold/documentary/property creative direction, source-grounded caption cues, and distinct Facebook/LinkedIn/Instagram copy. Public agent tools remain discovery and non-executing planning only.
pricing: Canonical customer price is $4.99 one-time (499 cents USD). An authenticated Clip checkout control plane and provider-verification path are deployed, but the live checkout gateway currently reports payment authority unconfigured, so this must not be represented as sell-now yet.
confirmation: Public discovery and planning create no payment obligation. Customer checkout requires an authenticated human and explicit $4.99 confirmation; rendering remains locked until Stripe reports paid + complete and exact amount, currency, and order metadata all verify.
payment_authority: Evercraft Clip clipCheckoutGateway + Stripe provider verification. Control plane is deployed and fail-closed; live gateway observed 2026-09-28 with checkout_configured=false, so payment creation remains unavailable until server-side authority is provisioned.
invocation_status: LIVE: Clip Production Engine V2, Customer Clip Studio, read-only Creative Director planning, and an authenticated checkout/provider-verification control plane are deployed. The live checkout offer reports 499 cents USD, explicit confirmation required, checkout creation not payment proof, and checkout_configured=false. Machine checkout is not enabled. ForensiScope remains the overflow path for oversized or full-timeline media.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
